scope: Pfluger/Lady Bird Lake district bounded by West 6th Street, Barton Springs Road, Congress Avenue and MoPac
status_rule: Listed candidate metadata is not permission to redistribute source content. Verify exact layer metadata, license, upstream rights, dates and district coverage before acquisition or derivatives.

included.redistribution: USGS-produced public-domain data; retain acknowledgement and provenance
unresolved: Native source tile lineage and acquisition epoch
Bare earth omits bridge decks and trees
Low outlier south of district retained and reported

included.redistribution: ODbL 1.0; retain attribution and applicable database share-alike/access obligations
unresolved: Deck elevations, path widths and physical clearances
Relations other than Lady Bird Lake not reconstructed
Building height tags are contributor claims; untagged/default heights are illustrative

candidates_not_included.role: compare terrain sources and identify lidar lineage
gates: Capture epoch, spacing and vertical datum

candidates_not_included.role: classified point clouds for terrain/buildings/canopy structure
gates: Select actual Austin district tiles and source survey

candidates_not_included.role: compare authoritative planimetric footprints and height attributes
gates: Date/coverage; two-dimensional geometry does not provide facade or deck structure
Verify meaning and validity of Z values
Widths, accessibility and physical continuity require evidence
No assumption of bridge/deck elevations from 2D linework
Park boundary is not a vegetation inventory
Derived-product rights and upstream imagery terms
Tree canopy polygons are not individual tree positions, species, roots or heights

candidates_not_included.role: ground cover and planimetric reference, if license permits
gates: City access does not itself authorize imagery redistribution
Imagery does not reveal under-canopy or under-bridge surfaces

candidates_not_included.catalog_license_label: CC BY-SA 4.0; recheck file page and creator before acquisition
gates: Pin file bytes, creator, version/date, license and modification notice
Decide reference-only vs incorporated/derived use and meet resulting terms
Dated photograph is not current survey evidence
Reference facts separately from copyrighted photos
Obtain a permitted image source before any image redistribution
Site descriptions do not specify collision geometry
